    """

    # Initialize current state and best-found state
    curr_x = np.random.uniform(low, high)
    curr_y = np.random.uniform(low, high)

    for i in range(iterations):
        # Progressively reduce the "temperature" for Simulated Annealing
        temp = 1.0 - (i / iterations) # Cooling schedule

        # Determine next candidate point (nx, ny)
        if np.random.rand() < 0.2:
            # Global jump for exploration
            nx, ny = np.random.uniform(low, high, 2)
